scope: Complete numerical review of the official Rock County, Wisconsin, November 3, 2026 unofficial general-election report.
input: All 53 source tables, including the blank layout table; 26 summary/detail pairs; all 106 participation reporting units; every candidate/option and unit vector; all 26 literal reporting statements.
independent_extraction: Standard-library HTMLParser, BeautifulSoup and Chromium DOM independently agree on every table cell in the complete original. Browser page scripts are disabled and all external requests blocked. No third-party templates, scripts or HTML are publicly mirrored.
arithmetic: Independently sum all 67 native unit vectors to their printed detail totals and summary counts. Compare all 65 candidate/option percentages to their contest selections, and the separate county participation percentage to registered voters, with Decimal half-up rounding to two places.
participation: Keep the literal Ballots Cast numerator and Registered Voters denominator separate from candidate selections. Native unit zero values remain literal; source detail totals are never added a second time. No native unit percentages are declared, so those remain missing.
scope_limitations: The county heading says unofficial results and votes reflect Rock County ONLY. Complete precinct reporting is not certification or proof of final counting. An explicit all-mode definition is not established by this numerical package. A separate scope/usability review is required before map or analysis-rate approval.
party_results: Preserve each literal candidate/option, party label, write-in status, summary votes and complete unit vectors, scoped to its contest. Do not sum party totals across contests or infer write-in party allegiance from the literal NONPARTISAN label. The source also labels all 18 referendum options NONPARTISAN; preserve those literal labels without treating them as partisan allegiance.
clocks: Preserve November 03, 2026 at 10:56 PM as the native update literal. No timezone is declared; do not infer one from geography, HTTP headers or acquisition time.
geography: Preserve literal unit names, including source spelling differences. The source does not declare Census FIPS. No padded native identifiers, precinct polygons, county identity join or geometry approvals are created here.
privacy: Complete original HTTP bodies remain private. Public input contains complete factual numerical table cells, literal reporting statements, safe receipts, methods and executable review/tests, never incidental webpage credentials.
reproduction: Run python3 -B -I review-county.py --output /new/output/directory and python3 -B -I test_review_county.py. All numerical inputs, complete tables, audit, checksums and a deterministic full-query ZIP reproduce offline using only the standard library.
